name: 3D Covariance Computation
aliases: Covariance Matrix Computation from Quaternions and Scales
Gaussian covariance from quaternion and scale
definition: Computes the 3D covariance matrix of a Gaussian from its scale and rotation parameters.
summary: 3D Covariance Computation derives valid covariance matrices from unconstrained quaternions and scales, avoiding projection steps required by direct optimization.
